Text: All data sources and computing services are considered resources and should use network and identity-aware access controls.  The enterprise monitors and measures the integrity and security posture of all owned and associated assets.
Establish, operate, and maintain a management program to enable the oversight and review of cybersecurity risk.
Member States shall ensure that entities take appropriate and proportionate technical and organisational measures to manage the risks posed to the security of network and information systems.

Financial entities shall have in place sound, comprehensive and well‑documented ICT risk-management frameworks that address risks quickly, comprehensively and effectively and ensure a high level of digital operational resilience.
Information security risk treatment plan shall be developed and implemented to determine appropriate management action, resources, responsibilities and priorities.
Member States shall ensure that essential and important entities notify, without undue delay, the competent authorities or CSIRT of any significant incident.
Continuous diagnostics and mitigation monitors the security posture of assets and ensures dynamic policy enforcement.
The organisation shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, including the methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation.
